description: Delete a document. Requires an API key with documents:write for a document you own, or `controlToken` for an anonymously published one. There is no endpoint to undo this: the document stops being served at once and its stored content is erased about a month later.

controlToken.description: Control token from an anonymous publish answer (pmt_...). Lets you act on that one document without an API key.

name: postmd_delete_document
